holding_summary: Municipal sewer-lien dispute over whether a street was validly dedicated to public use; has nothing to do with letting dwellings or rooms.
notes: Deed-dedication/street-easement case; no occupancy-for-pay issue at all.

holding_summary: Trespass action after ejectment execution; sister's possession was as her brother's housekeeper, not as a lodger or tenant paying for occupancy.
notes: Family occupancy/housekeeping arrangement incident to ejectment execution, not a compensated letting.

holding_summary: Upholds a borough peddler/canvasser licensing ordinance under the police power, but strikes down its exemption clause as an unreasonable classification; concerns door-to-door sales, not lodging or dwelling rentals.
notes: Peddler/hawker licensing ordinance case; no boarding-house or lodging-house regulation or letting of premises involved.

holding_summary: Procedural ruling on the sufficiency of an answer to a rule to bring ejectment against a life tenant's remainderman; no occupancy-for-pay facts.
notes: Life estate/remainder title dispute; unrelated to short-term letting or lodging.

holding_summary: Upholds constitutionality of a statute licensing junk shops and second-hand dealers under the police power; not itself about lodging houses or letting dwellings.
notes: In passing, the opinion cites Commonwealth v. Muir (1 Pa. Superior Ct. 579; aff'd 180 Pa. 47) as precedent that an act licensing public lodging houses was constitutional, but Mintz itself adjudicates junk-dealer licensing, not lodging. Muir may be worth pulling directly as an adverse-regulation candidate in a later shard, but this record does not qualify on its own facts.

holding_summary: Construes a commercial lease's renewal/rerenting privilege for two rooms in a building, holding the tenant exhausted his renewal right by giving notice of only a one-year extension.
notes: Ordinary annual commercial lease-renewal dispute (two rooms let at $125/year); no short-term or lodging character, no householder letting part of a residence.

holding_summary: Holds a landlord liable in negligence to one of several separately-leased tenants for injuries from a defective common stairway he was bound to maintain.
notes: Multi-tenant building with separate room leases, but the opinion addresses only the landlord's premises-liability duty over common stairways, not the character or duration of the lettings themselves — no lease/license/lodging characterization at issue.

holding_summary: Farm-tenancy dispute over entitlement to a way-going crop under a written lease versus local custom; agricultural, not residential/lodging letting.
notes: Farm lease/crop-share dispute; no bearing on letting rooms or dwellings.

holding_summary: Voids a Pittsburgh smoke-nuisance ordinance provision as unreasonable; concerns industrial smoke abatement under the police power, not lodging or dwelling regulation.
notes: Smoke-nuisance ordinance case; unrelated to letting or lodging.
